priorStatuses.title: Remove the message listener during cleanup

findings.title: [P2] Remove the message listener during cleanup
findings.body: This previously reported defect remains open after current-source revalidation. Evidence: At current head e207ecb55b1f147575ceb1ddffc9ddebc7e60aa9, src/socket.ts:2 still registers handler with socket.on("message", handler), while the changed disposer at line 3 is an empty function. Calling cleanup therefore leaves the exact handler registered; no alternate unregister path or callers exist in the repository.
